name: Xquic

variants.name: Xquiq
variants.verification: Observed in acquired text; normalization is editorial, not a statement of etymology.

notes: Modern display label is a lookup aid. Source spelling remains untouched. Daughter of Cuchumaquic; seeks the tree, speaks, negotiates with messengers, directs substitute heart and establishes household membership by the maize test (images 40–45). Not identified as daughter of One Death. Xkik’ is a modern search spelling, not a diplomatic manuscript reading.
